instruction.german: Rewrite the sentences using the adverb in brackets.

configs.correctAnswer: We never go to school on Saturdays.
She always watches TV before bed.
They are usually late for school.
I sometimes go to the skatepark at the weekend.

additionalAnswers.answer: Sometimes I go to the skatepark at the weekend.

configs.correctAnswer: You often use the computers in the library.
He is not often in the gym.

additionalAnswers.answer: He isn't often in the gym.
He's not often in the gym.

parts:
1 We go to school on Saturdays. (never)

2 She watches TV before bed. (always)

3 They are late for school. (usually)

4 I go to the park at the weekend. (sometimes)

5 You use the computers in the library. (often)

6 He is in the gym. (not often)
